description: This file defines extension functions for converting network models related to news resources into database entities and external models within the 'Now in Android' project. It includes functions for creating database entity representations, shell topics for foreign key constraints, cross-reference entries, and transforming network models into external data models, all tailored to the 'NewsResource' concept.

methods.name: asEntity
methods.description: Converts a NetworkNewsResource object into a NewsResourceEntity for database storage.

methods.name: topicEntityShells
methods.description: Creates placeholder TopicEntity objects for each topic ID associated with the news resource, used to satisfy foreign key constraints.

methods.name: topicCrossReferences
methods.description: Generates a list of NewsResourceTopicCrossRef objects linking news resources to their associated topics.

methods.name: asExternalModel
methods.description: Transforms a NetworkNewsResource into an external NewsResource model, associating it with a filtered list of NetworkTopic models.
